title_en: ROAM-GRPO: Enforcing Reasoning Diversity in GRPO via Routed Off-mode Approach Mining
title_zh: ROAM-GRPO：通过路由式非模式方法挖掘强制GRPO中的推理多样性
summary_en: The paper proposes ROAM-GRPO, an augmentation to the GRPO algorithm that addresses the low-diversity mode collapse in LLM post-training for reasoning tasks. ROAM-GRPO detects well-solved problems during training and transfers them to an "off-mode" track, where the model is prompted to produce distinct solution strategies. These strategies are verified for logical validity and distinctness by an LLM judge and then self-distilled into the policy. Training Qwen3.5-2b on a 1,000-problem subset of MATH level 5, ROAM-GRPO increases peak pass@16 by 4.7% and correct embedding cosine distance by approximately 1.5-2x on a difficult evaluation set.
summary_zh: 本文提出ROAM-GRPO，一种对GRPO算法的增强，旨在解决LLM推理任务后训练中策略坍缩为低多样性模式的问题。ROAM-GRPO在训练中检测已充分解决的问题，并将其转移到“非模式”轨道，提示模型生成不同的解题策略。这些策略由LLM评判器验证逻辑有效性和差异性，随后自蒸馏到策略中。在MATH 5级数据集的1000题子集上训练Qwen3.5-2b，ROAM-GRPO在困难评估集上将峰值pass@16提高了4.7%，并将正确嵌入余弦距离提升约1.5-2倍。
content_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) paired with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become the dominant recipe for post-training LLMs on complex reasoning tasks, but has been shown to collapse the policy into a low-diversity mode. Repeated LLM outputs are nearly identical, and pass@k accuracy converges or degrades as a result. We propose ROAM-GRPO (Routed Off-mode Approach Mining for GRPO), an augmentation to the GRPO algorithm which incentivizes exploration of distinct reasoning strategies and aims to increase output creativity during evaluation. ROAM-GRPO detects well-solved problems during training and transfers them to an "off-mode" track. The model is prompted to produce distinct solution strategies to such problems, which are verified for logical validity and distinctness by an LLM judge and subsequently self-distilled into the policy. Training Qwen3.5-2b on a 1,000-problem subset of the MATH lvl5 dataset, ROAM-GRPO implementation increases peak pass@16 by 4.7% and correct embedding cosine distance by approximately 1.5-2x on a difficult evaluation set.
content_zh: 监督微调（SFT）结合可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已成为在复杂推理任务上对 LLM 进行后训练的主流方案，但已被证明会使策略坍缩为低多样性模式。重复的 LLM 输出几乎完全相同，pass@k 准确率因此趋于收敛或下降。我们提出 ROAM-GRPO（Routed Off-mode Approach Mining for GRPO），这是对 GRPO 算法的一种增强，旨在激励模型探索不同的推理策略，并力图在评估期间提升输出的创造性。ROAM-GRPO 在训练过程中检测已充分解决的问题，并将其转移到“离模式”轨道。模型被提示为这类问题生成不同的解题策略，这些策略由 LLM 评判器验证其逻辑有效性与差异性，随后通过自蒸馏融入策略中。在 MATH lvl5 数据集的 1,000 道题子集上训练 Qwen3.5-2b 时，ROAM-GRPO 实现将峰值 pass@16 提升了 4.7%，并在一个困难的评估集上将正确嵌入余弦距离提升约 1.5-2 倍。
